digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler / Jira Data Center backend assembly
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend protocol because it is missing query_project and assert_env_ready members, despite both being implemented in Cloud's JiraBackend
reconciler.backend config validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' as a choice even though the backend is registered and reachable via select_backend, leaving it configured-but-unreachable

DC inbound identity mints silently fail because the accountId guard returns early (DC has no accountId) and the channel validation would reject 'jira-datacenter' outside CREATION_CHANNELS if the guard were bypassed
test_backend_contract.py fixture includes only fake and jira backends, so the DC backend has never been validated against the generic port contract suite
a writing reconcile pass against DC crashes on set_entity_property, a method the core calls from three sites that the TicketTransport Protocol never declared
